# Anime List

> Filter and explore anime and manga titles from MyAnimeList with advanced search, statistics, schedules, and watchlists.

## Developer docs

- [OpenAPI specification](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/openapi.json)
- [Agent catalog](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/api/ai)

## CLI

```bash
curl -s -H 'Accept: text/markdown' https://anime.significanthobbies.com/about
```
Full export contains authored static page content only. Live catalog data, title enrichment, search results and statistics are available through the individual Markdown routes; personal data is excluded.
MCP: https://anime.significanthobbies.com/api/mcp. Public catalog tools need no authentication; personal watchlist tools require a token.

<!-- Keep in sync with robots.txt and ai.txt. -->

## Public pages

- [Anime List — filter anime and manga](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/index.md): Filter and explore anime and manga titles from MyAnimeList with advanced search, statistics, schedules, and watchlists.
- [Advanced anime search — Anime List](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/search.md): Filter anime by score, year, genres, themes, demographics, popularity, status, and format with shareable search URLs.
- [Random anime picker — Anime List](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/random.md): Pick a random anime from the public Anime List catalog and narrow the choice with the same discovery filters used by search.
- [Anime catalog statistics — Anime List](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/stats.md): Explore anime score distributions, formats, years, genres, themes, demographics, popularity, and catalog coverage.
- [Advanced manga search — Anime List](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/manga.md): Search and filter more than 20,000 manga titles by score, year, genres, themes, demographics, status, and format.
- [Manga catalog statistics — Anime List](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/manga/stats.md): Explore manga score distributions, formats, years, genres, themes, demographics, popularity, and catalog coverage.
- [Anime List changelog](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/changelog.md): Verified product releases for Anime List, including anime and manga discovery, watchlists, schedules, and catalog improvements.
- [Anime List catalog updates](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/catalog-updates.md): Review daily anime and manga catalog ingestion history, update timing, and the latest public dataset refreshes.
- [About Anime List](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/about.md): Learn how Anime List combines MyAnimeList catalog data, advanced filtering, smart ranking, statistics, and personal tracking.
- [Anime List privacy](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/privacy.md): Understand Anime List account data, Google sign-in, watchlist storage, and product analytics.
- [Anime List terms](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/terms.md): Terms for using Anime List catalog discovery, personal watchlists, and MyAnimeList-derived metadata.
- [Anime List MCP setup](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/mcp.md): Connect agents to Anime List public catalog tools and manage a personal access token for authenticated watchlist tools.
- [Anime and manga title catalog](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/catalog.md): Browse source-backed public anime and manga titles.
